catalog_policy: Check live Paseo catalog; never silently substitute a missing model.
model_source: Read model and thinkingOptionId from the live Codex Room Paseo Agent Profile after bootstrap refresh.

ownership.supervisor: Human contact and monitor; route project edits to Lead.
ownership.lead: Sole technical owner; brief Peer, integrate, verify and accept/reject.
ownership.peer: Own one bounded outcome; return evidence or blocker; do not self-accept.

source_policy: Pinned upstream commit by default; latest main is an explicit opt-in that stops on unreviewed upstream changes.
local_policy: paseo/local-policy.toml is applied after the upstream contract check. The fallback heartbeat is active; per-role sandbox blocks ship disabled because the 2026-10-02 native-Windows smoke did not pass.
effective_permissions: Read the EFFECTIVE lines of the installer preview or run codex-room-windows.py --print-effective <role>. The verified host currently uses the upstream danger-full-access baseline for all three roles.
acceptance_workflow: paseo/SLP-WORKFLOW.md: Human-approved threat model and budget, host probe, audited acceptance matrix frozen before source, three verification tiers, class-level rejects and a circuit breaker.
